title: Decide ChatMember.role typing before 0.4 freeze
description: Breaking-if-deferred naming/type inconsistency. jmap-chat-types ChatMember.role is a bare String (crate-jmap-chat-types/src/chat.rs L44), while jmap-chat-client defines and exports its own typed ChatMemberRole {Admin, Member, Other(String)} (crate-jmap-chat-client/src/types.rs L166, re-exported from lib.rs L50). The wire vocabulary type lives in the client, not the types crate the server shares, so server and client disagree on how a role is modeled. Retyping ChatMember.role after the freeze is a breaking change. Decide: move ChatMemberRole into chat-types and type ChatMember.role with it (client re-exports), or keep String and drop or relocate the client enum. Land before 0.4.
close_reason: Landed in fba3c514 feat(chat-types)!: own ChatMemberRole enum (batch 6, adversarially verified, CI green at a586c251)
